findings.text: follow-on: the head gate result is recorded under the mistyped key after_sl_suite while the after_suite key is absent and baseline_suite is prose, so a promotion check reading the reviewed run's JSON arms reads the after-arm as unreadable although head_gate.log holds it.

follow-on: scripted_tree and the tier-1 decide_batch stubs land in a file the node's declared write scope does not list, so the node wrote outside its fence; the manifest records the dispatch as authorising it by name, so it is a declared scope extension rather than a silent one.

item_verdicts.diff: read commits 3fe14e03a and 630ed8ced against 62b4f009c; five files, 243 insertions and 60 deletions, each commit carrying a conventional subject and a body, and every added assertion names a condition under which the test fails.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py, test_domain_classifier_prompt.py, test_physics_domain_guidance.py, the new test file and the settings seat tests, run at base and head by delta; base_gate.log records 172 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1 and head_gate.log records 193 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1, giving added_failure_count 0 against the same pre-existing failure tests/core/test_settings.py::TestMapRunModelSeat::test_map_run_model_check_names_ids_mapping.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is a two-level Jev Choice that picks a category and then a domain with the chat classifier below a confidence threshold, with the DD path, the LLM description and the DD documentation reaching every decision; in the window read, imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:957 _answer_for reads each state's answer under its question name (used at :987, :1093, :1107) and :832 _format_batch_user_prompt emits the `documentation:` clause, so the inert-tree defect and the dropped-documentation defect the prior reviews named are both closed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at runs/r-20261013T160612001893-scg-jev-domain-tree/manifest.md and lifted from the reviewed run's classification.json; status complete, three negative-control logs each EXIT=1, but the head arm sits under a mistyped after_sl_suite key while after_suite is absent, so a JSON reader of the record sees the after-arm as unreadable (see the finding).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared scope in brief.md is seven files plus one figure directory; git diff 62b4f009c..630ed8ced changes five files, four inside the declared scope and tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py outside it, which the reviewed run's manifest records as authorised by the dispatch that asked for the tier-1 stubs.

justifications.durability: tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier_jev.py:654 reddens when _answer_for is reverted to the flat result[0] read and tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py:371 reddens when the documentation render at imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:832 is dropped, both measured as red runs.
justifications.evidence: head_gate.log records 193 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1 against base_gate.log 172 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1, so added_failure_count is 0, though the reviewed record carries the head arm as a mistyped key rather than in after_suite.
justifications.fit: _answer_for at imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:957 follows the module's own helper idiom and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:957 _answer_for replaces the flat read that made decide_domain_tree inert and :832 emits the documentation clause the chat path was dropping, so both requirements the goal states are met in the window read.
justifications.reuse: the answer unwrap has no repository owner; a capability search over imas_codex found only inline answers.get(name) reads (imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:3359, imas_codex/discovery/code/scorer.py:331, imas_codex/discovery/signals/role.py:59) and decide_domain_tree wraps the decisions owner at imas_codex/discovery/base/judgment.py:230.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 62b4f009c..630ed8ced changes four files inside the brief's declared scope and adds tests/graph/test_dd_domain_classifier.py:108 scripted_tree outside it, authorised by the dispatch and declared in the manifest.
